_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.label: Find ground for a village in his lordship's name

title: Ground for a village
A new village of the domain
Land in his lordship's name
summary: His lordship would found a village. Find good ground {distance} from {settlement}: gentle land, water near, clear of other towns.
The domain must grow. Find ground for a new village, founded in his lordship's name.
Ride out and find land for a village of the domain, {distance} from here.
offer: His lordship has younger sons and landless men enough to found a village. Find them ground, {distance} from here: flat, watered, clear of others.
The domain grows or it withers. Find me land for a village, and it will bear his lordship's name.
Ride out, find good ground for a village, stand on it, and come back.
progress: Is there land for the village?
complete: Good land. The settlers go out in his lordship's name.
A fine site. The domain is the larger for it.
That will do well. The village will carry his lordship's name.
